result.topic_en: A referee-style note (probably not by Ramanujan) saying a paper is hard to follow after page 1, that the source of equation (12) is unclear, and that the values m = 5, k = 8 quoted on page 3 do not follow from the given value of k, [x/m], because x is negative.
result.transcription:
Paper a little difficult to understand after the 1st page. I don't see
where eqn (12) comes from, & $m = 5,\ k = 8$ (quoted on page 3) does
not come from the value of $k$ given $[\frac{x}{m}]$, as $x$ is $-$ve.
